result.topic_en: Calculations on the equations of motion of a rotating fluid ellipsoid with semi-axes a, b, c and rotation components u, v, w, u', v', w', examining special cases (b = c, u' = 0, etc.), stationary solutions and integrals of the motion.

methods.what: Equations of motion of a homogeneous fluid ellipsoid with variable semi-axes a,b,c and internal/external rotation components (Dirichlet–Riemann ellipsoid equations)
Special case b=c of the rotation equations
Stationary ratio of rotation components in terms of axes
Substitution of new variables p,q,r and an integral (constant) of the motion
Integral in terms of π, χ, ρ
Case u'=0, b=c: rotation equations reduce to rigid rotation, conserved v^2+w^2 and angle parametrization
Case analysis of vanishing rotation components for stationary solutions
